script_text: Libra, stop, your ruling planet Venus is clashing with your Sun, and it is about to cost you real money. You are an air sign ruled by Venus, and now Venus transits your 4th House of Home in Capricorn, forming a hard square to your natal Sun, while Jupiter in Leo trines the Sun across your 3rd House of Communication, linking ideas to real income. That Venus square means a partner pushes a money or home question, moving in, a purchase, and it lands wrong; single Libras, a sharp conversation attracts someone, but vet their home goals. In your 11th House, Jupiter trines that Sun, so take the call, a pitch or referral converts into a fee today. Avoid signing anything home or money related; that same square turns a good deal into regret. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss what is coming.
